strengths.mechanism: Character creation separates description, greeting and image.
strengths.benefitInference: Specific premise fields may help creators establish a scene.

strengths.mechanism: Per-character named chats, folders, duplication and New Chat.
strengths.benefitInference: Readers may resume exact stories while keeping alternatives separate.

strengths.mechanism: A branch copies messages through a chosen point and retains an origin link.
strengths.benefitInference: Readers may explore alternatives and return to the original scene.

strengths.mechanism: HypaV3 summaries support edits, regeneration with apply/cancel, source references and selection labels.
strengths.benefitInference: Readers may diagnose and repair compressed story memory. Recall quality was not tested.

strengths.mechanism: Multiple transcript exports and recognized native/JSONL imports.
strengths.benefitInference: Readers gain preservation and migration routes. Lossless migration is not established.

tradeoffs.note: Many documented settings and extension mechanisms create concepts to learn. Successful progressive disclosure was not established.
Small-screen message menus consolidate actions; discoverability and touch usability remain untested.
Import support establishes parsing paths, not preservation of every message, branch, asset or extension.
Docker instructions establish a self-hosting route, not operational reliability or multiuser isolation.
The README labels its linked wiki work in progress. The inspected creation guide does not establish current deployed navigation.

unknowns.note: Full assembled-request visibility, activated-lore inspection and token allocation were not established. A model-information button alone is insufficient.
Character-card migration fidelity and media round trips were not verified.
Memory accuracy, long-chat performance and recovery from failed provider requests were not tested.
Actual mobile layouts, keyboard use, touch targets and Android installation were not tested.
Voice setup and image-generation configuration were not established. Embedded assets and TTS are documented.
Self-host authentication, backups, upgrade safety and deployment parity remain unknown.

reusablePatterns.note: Proposal: show each branch origin and group related branches to preserve exact-story navigation.
Proposal: expose editable summaries, source-message links and selection reasons before adding more memory automation.
Proposal: keep New Chat distinct from named-story selection; test with several similar stories.
Proposal: place export beside story management and distinguish editable archives from readable transcripts.

doNotCopy.note: Do not promise unlimited or accurate memory without evidence, or treat generated summaries as canonical story text.
Do not adopt condensed icon menus without testing discovery of branch, retry and recovery actions.
Do not promise universal export compatibility without migration fixtures.

characterOnboarding.note: Maintainer guide covers character name, description, greeting and image. Website advertises RisuRealm discovery. Import fidelity and current deployed onboarding were not verified.

storyOrganization.note: Per-character named chats, folders, copying, selection and New Chat are implemented in the sidebar.

editRetryBranch.note: Edit and reroll controls; branch copies through the chosen message, receives a new id and records a navigable origin.

memoryLore.note: Editable HypaV3 summaries, source references, regeneration with apply/cancel and selection labels. Lorebooks are documented in README. Quality was not tested.

promptTransparency.note: Prompt reordering, conditions and variables are documented. Source exposes conditional model information; complete request/context inspection remains unknown.

modelConnections.note: README lists OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, DeepInfra, Ooba and OpenRouter support. Connections and failover were not exercised.

advancedControls.note: README documents regex scripts, plugins, prompt ordering, variables and conditions. Defaults and ease of use remain untested.

groupRoleplay.note: README documents multiple characters in one chat. Turn-taking behavior was not tested.

imagesVoice.note: Emotion images, embedded images/audio/video and TTS are documented. Generation-provider configuration, voice quality and dictation were not established.

mobile.note: Message controls use a named popup below 640 pixels. Website advertises Android and web; no device testing or install verification.

portability.note: Chat export offers JSON, TXT and HTML variants; import recognizes native schemas and JSONL. No lossless migration or character-card round trip verified.

selfHosting.note: README provides Docker hosting instructions. No deployment, operational or security checks ran.
